card.name: Modifier after the, before a noun
card.fires_on: A modifier or proper-name word right after 'the' or 'a' that is followed by a noun, mostly in general web text. Examples are place or brand names (Boston, Sega) and adjectives (introduced, conventional, first).

modes.label: Newspaper or brand name
modes.description: A proper name after 'the' that begins a title or product name.
modes.example: The New York Times and The<< Boston>> Globe. John Bisbee and his art

modes.label: Adjective before a noun
modes.description: A descriptive adjective after 'the' or 'a', with the noun still to come.
modes.example: due to the advance of the<< introduced>> cane toad. In recent years around

modes.label: Nationality or comparison word
modes.description: A nationality or comparison word that leads into a noun.
modes.example: early 20th-century arrival of<< American>> and British newspaper strips.

card.plain: It fires on a descriptive or naming word that comes before the noun it modifies, such as the 'Boston' in 'The Boston Globe'.
